 Print The Madhya Pradesh Agency for Promotion of Information Technology (MAP IT) has released the CPCT admit card 2026 for candidates appearing in the Madhya Pradesh Computer Proficiency Certification Test (CPCT). Applicants who have registered for the examination can now access and download their hall tickets through the official website, cpct.mp.gov.in, using their login credentials. The CPCT 2026 examination is scheduled to be conducted on November 13, 14, and 15, 2026, at designated examination centres across Madhya Pradesh. Candidates must download their admit cards well before the examination and verify the details mentioned on them to avoid last-minute difficulties. The admit card is a mandatory document for entry into the examination centre. Candidates must also carry a valid photo identity card matching the details specified on their hall ticket. Those who fail to produce the required documents may not be permitted to appear for the test. CPCT admit card 2026: Steps to download hall ticket
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the CPCT admit card 2026 on the official website: Visit the official website of CPCT at cpct.mp.gov.in.
 Navigate to the candidate login section on the homepage.
 Enter the required login credentials, as prompted.
 Submit the details to access the candidate dashboard.
 Locate the CPCT Admit Card 2026 download link.
 Open the admit card and verify the information mentioned on it.
 Download the hall ticket and take a clear printout for examination-day use.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the CPCT admit card 2026. Why is the CPCT examination important?
 The Madhya Pradesh Computer Proficiency Certification Test serves as an assessment of computer-related competencies required for several government positions in the state. The certification is relevant to recruitment for posts such as Data Entry Operator, Clerk, Assistant Grade 3 and Stenographer, among other positions where computer knowledge and typing proficiency are prescribed eligibility requirements. Through the test, the authorities assess whether candidates possess the basic digital skills required to perform administrative and data-handling responsibilities. These include familiarity with computers, general IT knowledge and typing proficiency in the prescribed languages. Candidates should note that CPCT certification requirements may vary across recruitment notifications. They must check the eligibility conditions of the specific post for which they intend to apply.
